description: This file defines the DataGroupAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing data groups within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides an implementation for retrieving all data group permissions and stubs for create and delete operations, which are not yet implemented.

classes.name: DataGroupAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing endpoints to interact with data groups and their permissions in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all data group permissions accessible to the current user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method, currently an empty collection.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Stub method for creating a data group, throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for create operation, currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Stub method for deleting a data group, throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation, currently throws NotImplementedException.
